mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% in 1 month do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the condition FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS changes and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals robust demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and RSAFS increases > 2% YoY
failure_condition: If the joint condition of HOUST increasing > 10% YoY and RSAFS increasing > 2% YoY does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained decrease in FEDFUNDS over three months does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
